response.overview: Aladdin jr. is the story of an orphan boy named Aladdin who tries to whew the heart of Princess Jasmine, with the help of his friends Babkak, Omar, and Kassim. This is when he comes across a lamp that reveals the all powerful and wisecracking Genie, whom he uses to accomplish his goals. But little does the kingdom of Agrabah know that the royal visit Jafar had been plotting to take over the crown to make his own. Now, it’s up to Aladdin and his crew to take him down and realize that being yourself is better than living a lie.  All rights to their original owners
response.tagline: Mahar Theater encourages you to take a magic carpet ride into “A Whole New World” as they perform Disney’s Aladdin Jr.
